lines.zh: 我的脚踩下去，蕨类就没了。
lines.en: Where I set my foot, the ferns are gone.

lines.zh: 脚下的根须拖在地上，像第二条腿。
lines.en: Roots drag behind me like a second pair of legs.

lines.zh: 我穿过丛林，叶子都在给我让路。
lines.en: I cross the jungle and the leaves part for me.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我的肩膀就掉几片叶。
lines.en: Each step shakes a few leaves off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，撞开挡道的灌木。
lines.en: I take no detours; I shove the blocking shrubs aside.

lines.zh: 藤蔓在我腿间缠紧，又松开。
lines.en: Vines cinch between my legs, then loosen.

lines.zh: 我和树说话，树不回答。
lines.en: I speak to the trees, and the trees say nothing.

lines.zh: 脚步声比雷远得慢，但同样闷。
lines.en: My footsteps arrive later than thunder, just as heavy.

lines.zh: 树冠太矮，我得低着头走。
lines.en: The canopy is too low; I walk with my head down.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下一个能积水的坑。
lines.en: My footprint leaves a hollow that will hold water.

lines.zh: 叶子在风里翻，我也跟着晃。
lines.en: Leaves turn in the wind, and I sway with them.

lines.zh: 我踩断的枝条，明天会长回来。
lines.en: The branches I break will grow back tomorrow.

lines.zh: 闻着土味走，就不会迷路。
lines.en: I follow the smell of soil and never get lost.

lines.zh: 木之巨人是我的亲戚，它更硬。
lines.en: The Wood Giant is my kin; it is harder than me.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，泥从脚趾间挤出来。
lines.en: I lift a foot and mud squeezes between my toes.

lines.zh: 枝条从肩上垂下，扫过灌木顶。
lines.en: Branches hang from my shoulders, brushing the brush tops.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，鸟就落在我肩上。
lines.en: I stand still and a bird lands on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过叶子，在我胸口画格子。
lines.en: Sunlight through the leaves draws a grid on my chest.

lines.zh: 我在长，只是慢到看不出来。
lines.en: I am growing, just too slowly to notice.

lines.zh: 背上的苔藓又厚了一层。
lines.en: The moss on my back is one layer thicker.

lines.zh: 风一停，我的叶子就没话说。
lines.en: When the wind stops, my leaves have nothing to say.

lines.zh: 我学着树的样子，一站就是半天。
lines.en: I stand like a tree for half a day.

lines.zh: 我出生的那天，就多长了一身叶。
lines.en: The day I was born, I grew a coat of leaves.

lines.zh: 森林里有太多声音，我不急着回。
lines.en: The forest has many voices; I answer none quickly.

lines.zh: 藤蔓顺着我爬到高处，我不介意。
lines.en: Vines climb me toward the height, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我在数年轮，可我没有年轮。
lines.en: I count my rings, except I have no rings.

lines.zh: 雨落在我身上，比落在石头上轻。
lines.en: Rain lands softer on me than on bare stone.

lines.zh: 我把叶子收一收，像穿衣。
lines.en: I fold my leaves in, the way one dresses.

lines.zh: 你看我时，得用手扶住脖子。
lines.en: When you look at me, you must hold your neck.

lines.zh: 你身上没有苔，真干净。
lines.en: You carry no moss at all; how clean.

lines.zh: 我低头的时候，叶子遮住眼睛。
lines.en: When I lower my head, leaves cover my eyes.

lines.zh: 你怕我踩你，对吗。
lines.en: You are afraid I will step on you, are you not?

lines.zh: 我看了很久，才认出你是活物。
lines.en: It took me long to see you are alive.

lines.zh: 你的斧头亮，我认得那种光。
lines.en: Your axe is bright; I know that kind of shine.

lines.zh: 我眨眼睛很慢，那不是困。
lines.en: I blink very slowly, and it is not sleepiness.

lines.zh: 你在我影子里站着，凉快吧。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow; it must feel cool.

lines.zh: 我的脸藏在叶子里，你看不清。
lines.en: My face hides in leaves; you cannot see it clearly.

lines.zh: 你很小，但你的心跳很大声。
lines.en: You are small, yet your heartbeat is loud.

lines.zh: 你砍进树皮，只到第二层。
lines.en: You cut bark and reached only the second layer.

lines.zh: 木屑飞起来，我怕你扎眼。
lines.en: Wood chips fly; they might get in your eyes.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我掉了半边叶。
lines.en: That slash cost me half my leaves.

lines.zh: 疼，慢慢疼，像树被折。
lines.en: It hurts slowly, like a tree being bent.

lines.zh: 我的血流得很慢，是树汁。
lines.en: My blood runs slowly, and it is sap.

lines.zh: 砍倒我要很久，你确定吗。
lines.en: Felling me takes a long time; are you sure?

lines.zh: 断口明年会结一层新皮。
lines.en: The cut will grow a new layer of skin next year.

lines.zh: 你不累，我也不会先倒。
lines.en: You are not tired; neither will I fall first.

lines.zh: 别砍根，那是我的腿。
lines.en: Do not cut the roots; those are my legs.

lines.zh: 我的伤，森林都记着。
lines.en: The forest remembers every wound I take.

lines.zh: 骨头汤？我只喝土里的水。
lines.en: Bone broth? I only drink water from the soil.

lines.zh: 面包在你手里，像一粒碎屑。
lines.en: The bread in your hand looks like a crumb.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我泡在雨里。
lines.en: I do not eat; I soak in the rain instead.

lines.zh: 那束花不错，放下吧。
lines.en: That bunch of flowers is nice; set it down.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张不开，木头咬不动。
lines.en: My mouth barely opens; wood does not chew.

lines.zh: 你拿种子哄我，我是一棵树。
lines.en: You tempt me with seeds, but I am a tree.

lines.zh: 食物落地，会变成肥料。
lines.en: Food dropped here turns into fertilizer.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我怕咬到。
lines.en: Do not reach out; I fear I might bite you.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢你手里那把斧头。
lines.en: I prefer the axe in your hand.

lines.zh: 收好吧，我饿的时候不这样。
lines.en: Put it away; I am not hungry like this.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: Hit me and you hit a wall.

lines.zh: 我的树皮很硬，你的肩膀还好吗。
lines.en: My bark is hard; how is your shoulder?

lines.zh: 你推不动我，根已经扎下去了。
lines.en: You cannot push me; my roots have taken hold.

lines.zh: 我被撞得掉了三片叶子。
lines.en: That bump shook three leaves off me.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的腿，那里全是刺藤。
lines.en: Do not press against my leg; thorn vines grow there.

lines.zh: 你从我脚边挤过去，慢一点。
lines.en: You squeeze past my foot; go slowly.

lines.zh: 相撞之后，地上多了个坑。
lines.en: After we collided, the ground gained a pit.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，压塌了两丛灌木。
lines.en: One step back flattened two shrubs.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖撞到你的盾，声音很闷。
lines.en: My knee met your shield with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of rust, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，只有我一个这么大。
lines.en: In this forest, only I am this large.

lines.zh: 木之巨人不算，它太沉默了。
lines.en: The Wood Giant does not count; it is too silent.

lines.zh: 我等了很多年，没等到同类。
lines.en: I waited years and no kin came.

lines.zh: 花开了又谢，我还是一个人。
lines.en: Flowers bloom and fade, and I remain alone.

lines.zh: 我身上的叶子，算是我的孩子。
lines.en: The leaves on me are the closest to children.

lines.zh: 同类要长这么大，得几百年。
lines.en: For kin to grow this big would take centuries.

lines.zh: 别替我难过，树本来就这样。
lines.en: Do not grieve for me; trees are simply like this.

lines.zh: 有伴的话，这片林子就不够分。
lines.en: With a partner, this forest would not be enough.

lines.zh: 我把种子撒得到处都是。
lines.en: I scatter seeds wherever I walk.

lines.zh: 也许有一天，某棵苗会长成我。
lines.en: One day a sapling might grow into me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，又放下了。
lines.en: I pick up a stone, then set it down.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我大多踩碎。
lines.en: Most things dropped here I simply crush.

lines.zh: 这根木棍不错，我插在背上。
lines.en: This stick is good; I tuck it on my back.

lines.zh: 你的剑太小，我夹不住。
lines.en: Your sword is too small for my fingers.

lines.zh: 我捡东西靠脚，不靠手。
lines.en: I pick things up with my feet, not my hands.

lines.zh: 这朵花我拿着，明天就枯了。
lines.en: I hold this flower; by tomorrow it wilts.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币陷进泥里了。
lines.en: That coin has sunk into the mud.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我拿去喂鸟。
lines.en: Fallen fruit I leave for the birds.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，捡完就不想站直。
lines.en: I bend slowly and do not want to straighten up.

lines.zh: 手里的东西，会被我的根缠住。
lines.en: Whatever I hold gets tangled by roots.

lines.zh: 有东西在砍我的树，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is cutting my trees; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你踩断枝条的声音，传得很远。
lines.en: The snap of branches under you carries far.

lines.zh: 我转身很慢，但我不会跟丢。
lines.en: I turn slowly, but I never lose the trail.

lines.zh: 九点力气，压下去你就起不来。
lines.en: Nine points of force will keep you down.

lines.zh: 这片丛林归我照看，你不该来。
lines.en: I tend this jungle; you should not be here.

lines.zh: 叶子往一个方向倒，那就是你。
lines.en: The leaves bow one way, and that way is you.

lines.zh: 一百三十五点，够撑到你放弃。
lines.en: A hundred and thirty-five points will outlast you.

lines.zh: 我认得你斧头的响声。
lines.en: I know the ring of your axe.

lines.zh: 你砍一棵，我就追你一里。
lines.en: Cut one tree and I chase you a mile.

lines.zh: 我的根已经醒了，正在找你。
lines.en: My roots have woken and are seeking you.

lines.zh: 别往树上爬，那是我够得到的地方。
lines.en: Do not climb; that is within my reach.

lines.zh: 丛林安静了，说明你停了。
lines.en: The jungle went quiet, which means you stopped.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过来，地都在抖。
lines.en: I press forward step by step, and the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，可我的影子很宽。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree; my shadow is wide.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，藤蔓先动。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, the vines move first.

lines.zh: 别跑向河边，那里没有路。
lines.en: Do not run for the river; there is no path.

lines.zh: 我耗得起，你的力气耗不起。
lines.en: I can outlast you; your strength cannot.

lines.zh: 你砍我的腿，只砍到木头。
lines.en: You strike my leg and cut only wood.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在叶缝里，一直看着你。
lines.en: My eyes behind the leaves never leave you.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块土，是我的根。
lines.en: The soil under you is my root.

lines.zh: 再近十步，你就进了我的范围。
lines.en: Ten steps closer and you are in my reach.

lines.zh: 我不喊，森林替我喊。
lines.en: I do not shout; the forest shouts for me.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越快了。
lines.en: Your breathing is getting faster and faster.

lines.zh: 别指望天暗下来，我看得见。
lines.en: Do not wait for dark; I can still see.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你会飞出去。
lines.en: This blow is not heavy; you will fly anyway.

lines.zh: 九点的力气，落在你肋骨上。
lines.en: Nine points of force, landing on your ribs.

lines.zh: 我的拳头是树桩，砸下去会响。
lines.en: My fist is a stump; it lands with a thud.

lines.zh: 你退了，地上的草被我踩平。
lines.en: You fell back, and I flattened the grass.

lines.zh: 打到盾上，我的指节裂了。
lines.en: The strike hit your shield and split my knuckle.

lines.zh: 我把你拍进泥里，别急着起来。
lines.en: I swat you into the mud; do not rush up.

lines.zh: 疼的是我，叫的是你。
lines.en: I am the one hurt; you are the one yelling.

lines.zh: 这一掌带着叶子和土。
lines.en: This palm comes with leaves and dirt.

lines.zh: 你的护甲凹了一块，看得见。
lines.en: A dent shows in your armor now.

lines.zh: 我的手臂慢，落点却避不开。
lines.en: My arm swings slowly, yet the landing is unavoidable.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，身上还带着芽。
lines.en: I rise from the soil still wearing sprouts.

lines.zh: 这片丛林今天多了一棵树。
lines.en: This jungle has one more tree today.

lines.zh: 出生那刻，我就比别的树高。
lines.en: At birth I stood taller than the other trees.

lines.zh: 我的关节刚开始是软的。
lines.en: My joints were soft at first.

lines.zh: 林子给了我叶子，也给了我腿。
lines.en: The forest gave me leaves, then gave me legs.

lines.zh: 木之巨人看了我一眼，走开了。
lines.en: The Wood Giant looked at me once and walked off.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的土，落了一地。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off and it rains down.

lines.zh: 阳光很好，适合长个子。
lines.en: The sun is good; it suits growing taller.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的，是树冠。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was the canopy.

lines.zh: 这片地归我，我站定了。
lines.en: This ground is mine; I have taken my stand.

lines.zh: 火一上身，我的叶子卷成小筒。
lines.en: Fire takes hold and my leaves curl into tubes.

lines.zh: 倒下时压断了三棵小树。
lines.en: Falling, I snapped three young trees.

lines.zh: 水漫过根，我的力气散了。
lines.en: Water covers my roots and my strength scatters.

lines.zh: 气浪掀我一跤，土灌进树皮缝。
lines.en: The blast knocks me down and soil fills my bark.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，像一根嫩枝。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a twig.

lines.zh: 那味道让我的叶子发黑。
lines.en: That smell turns my leaves black.

lines.zh: 没有阳光，我的叶子开始发黄。
lines.en: Without sun my leaves begin to yellow.

lines.zh: 雷劈开我的枝，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Lightning split my limb and white smoke rose.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有根可以扎，我飘着。
lines.en: No root can take hold in the void; I drift.
